name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a feature for ЧАРО messenger

labels: enhancement, triage

## Problem Statement
A clear description of what problem this feature would solve. Example: "I'm frustrated when I can't find a specific message in a group chat..."

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
- How do other messengers solve this?
- Any mockups or screenshots?

## Impact
How many users would benefit from this feature?
- [ ] All users
- [ ] Most users
- [ ] Some users
- [ ] Few users
